Message: Stop, I beg you, please...!
The city continues to crumble.

One by one,
my family, my friends...
Everyone turns to dust...

No... Stop...! Wait...!
Everyone, everyone is...!
Ah... Ahh... Aaaaaaaah—!

Haah... So, even ghosts
can have dreams, huh...?

That was the day I became
the “Witch of Murder.”

I saw everyone before me
turn to dust.

And all I could do was
stand by and watch...

I’ve never been able to
shake away that guilt.
It never goes away,
no matter what I do...
And now, once again...
Yubera had collapsed.

The girl’s life was about to end,
with her painting left unfinished,
and the sin I caused her to commit
still haunting her...

And yet, right now,
I can’t do anything to stop it.

It’s happening again...
Even now,
all I can do is watch...!

Yet another girl
whose life I destroyed is
about to die before my eyes...!

Please, someone, help...!
That girl...and me...!
I beg you...!

Just then...Fia approached
the collapsed Yubera...

while holding my flower
in her hand...
